# The Wasteland Table
[bold][color=#E7C78D]A well-fed wanderer lives to tell the tale.[/color][/bold]
A leather-bound collection of cooking recipes, from a simple cutlet to a full wasteland feast. Choose a chapter from the contents, then use the filter to find a dish.
## Before you light the stove
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] Whole items are counted separately from liquids. Liquid amounts are measured in units (u).
[bold]Method:[/bold] Use a compatible cooking machine, add every listed ingredient, then cook for the stated time.
[bold]Alternatives:[/bold] Some dishes have more than one recipe. Each version is kept separately with its own ingredients.
